			base = 20

			modifier = { factor = 0.25 monthly_manpower < 1 }
		}
	}
}

			base = 50

			modifier = { factor = 0.84 at_war = yes }
		}
		add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty

		if = {
			limit = { has_advance = antq_regional_militias }
			add_army_tradition = army_tradition_weak_bonus
		}
	}
	option = {

			modifier = { factor = 0.25 monthly_manpower < 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Odoacer's Deposition; ANTIQVITAS master plan §9; recipient=XAA
antq_m10_final.5012 = {
	type = country_event
	title = antq_m10_final.5012.title
	desc = antq_m10_final.5012.desc
	outcome = positive
	fire_only_once = yes
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event/antq_odoacer_finale.dds"
	dynamic_historical_event = {
		tag = XAA
		from = 476.1.1
		to = 476.9.4
		monthly_chance = 100
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_final.5012.a
		historical_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = { factor = 1.24 stability >= 20 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.84 at_war = yes }
		}
		# OUP-ODO: terminal Western-Roman identity adapter; campaign end remains 476.9.4.
		change_tag_cosmetic = { tag = ODO }
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
		# Learned practice shapes the response; it never gates the current.
		if = {
			limit = { has_advance = antq_migration_networks }
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_final.5012.b
		add_gold = -18
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = { factor = 1.6 stability < 0 }
			modifier = { factor = 0.6 gold < 30 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = antq_m10_final.5012.c
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
		add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = { factor = 1.75 at_war = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 0.25 monthly_manpower < 1 }
		}
	}
}
